name: Stompgate
author: Nick Lozano
description: Unofficial, not affiliated with Neural DSP. Neural DSP Quad Cortex in the Omarchy bar while Cortex Control runs: show or hide the editor, switch scenes, toggle the tuner and set the QC's audio.

barWidget.description: Unofficial. Needs the stompgate package. Shows or hides Cortex Control and switches the Quad Cortex's scenes, modes, tuner and audio.

schema.label: Show icon
schema.description: running: only while Cortex Control is open (default). connected: also while the Quad Cortex is plugged in and on. always: never hide.
